title: Demographic Confounding Causes Extreme Instances of Lifestyle Politics on Facebook
reasoning: The paper uses Facebook interest data to study political polarization and demographic confounding. While it categorizes and mentions interest topics such as 'Christian Zionism', 'Religion/Spirituality', and 'personal morality', it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics within the context of model performance, AI alignment, or LLM evaluation.
